chapters.expected: Connect glasses and the Captions tile are present, with no miniapp or sheet open.

chapters.instruction: Open Settings to verify the exclusively allocated account.
Open Profile and compare its email with the exclusive account grant.
chapters.expected: Profile shows the allocated account email.

chapters.instruction: Close Profile and return to Phone mode home.
chapters.expected: Home is idle after account verification.

chapters.instruction: Open the preserved Notes miniapp from idle Home.
chapters.expected: Today and Resume are visible with transcription paused.

chapters.instruction: Open the saved list without changing any notes.
chapters.expected: The preserved edited note is listed exactly once.

chapters.instruction: Reopen the preserved edited note without changing it.
chapters.expected: The edited title and appended review sentence are readable.

chapters.instruction: Scroll the existing note toward its lower body without editing.
chapters.expected: The saved note remains open with its review sentence intact.

chapters.instruction: Focus the saved note body without entering or changing text.
chapters.expected: The existing review sentence remains intact.

notes: Local exploration reopened the previously edited note and confirmed full body persistence, then failed NAV-FOCUS-BODY with AXPress -25204. Original teardown and return are deferred, fixture recovery-required and evidence failed. Payload mapping preserves these as blocked/unavailable/incomplete. Native action remains unreconciled; app/audio/account custody is unchanged. Finalized video is retained locally and excluded from publication because complete-media verification was not established. No incident was filed. The local operator is separate from the committed harness. This is not the earlier full Notes run and does not replace its failed result.
